ideas.pitch: Real-time leaderboard visualizer with historical rating trajectory graphs during competitive programming contests.
ideas.title: Codeforces Live Rank Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the Codeforces platform context of the contest, providing instant utility for spectators and participants.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first browser extension for competitive programmers to quickly search, filter, and copy pre-written algorithm templates.
ideas.title: CP Algorithm Cheat Sheet and Snippet Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a tangible friction point for participants in offline coding contests needing fast access to data structure templates.

ideas.pitch: A local CLI tool that automates generating edge-case random test cases and cross-checks two competing script outputs against each other.
ideas.title: Contest Submission Stress Tester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering and reliability, giving competitive programmers an edge in catching bugs before submission.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight app that analyzes a participant's recent Codeforces submissions and recommends weak-topic practice problems.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Problem Recommender
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Codeforces API to deliver an immediately working demo with practical utility for algorithmic training.

ideas.pitch: A live web scoreboard specifically tailored for managing and displaying individual knockout match standings for final rounds.
ideas.title: Knockout Match Bracket Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the logistical need for transparent tournament progression tracking during the final knockout stage.
